name: archie
description: Archie's engineering skill bundle, grouped by the phases it runs in.

plugins.name: archie-planning
plugins.description: Setup and Planning: prepare a repo, then architect one Epic at a time down to specs and tasks.

plugins.name: archie-implementing
plugins.description: Implementing: build one Task inline or a whole leaf Epic through engineer sub-agents, or get guided through the hands-on ones. Requires Archie Planning.

plugins.name: archie-reviewing
plugins.description: Reviewing: grade a PR, branch or Epic for mergeability and turn findings into the next fix Task. Requires Archie Implementing.
